Prayer · Light · AI

An app to help you pray

You choose the topic and length of your prayer.
Lampada helps with questions, finds Scripture passages, and gently keeps your answers in a journal.

Completely free, with no ads or purchases.

Download on the App Store Coming soon to Google Play Discover Lampada ↓

The app gives no answers. It asks questions.

  1. 01

    A flame for every day

    The lamp on the home screen glows brighter on the days you pray. Seven dots show the last seven days — a quiet reminder, not a contest.

  2. 02

    Choose a topic and a time

    Write what you bring to God, or start an open prayer. Pick 5, 15 or 30 minutes, an hour, set your own time, or pray with no timer at all.

  3. 03

    Questions that lead deeper

    During prayer, Lampada asks questions about your topic, written by AI. They are only prompts — you can skip any of them.

  4. 04

    Answer in your own words

    Type your answer to the question; it is saved in your journal. If you allow it, your answers are sent to the server so the AI can shape the next question and the Scripture passages around them.

  5. 05

    Or say it aloud

    If you would rather not type, record your answer with your voice. A recording can be turned into text with one tap.

  6. 06

    Scripture that fits your prayer

    Lampada picks Bible passages by the meaning of your topic and answers. Listen to them and save the ones you want to keep.

  7. 07

    A closing thought

    At the end, Lampada asks one last question. Write a line or two to take with you — it is saved with the prayer.

  8. 08

    Your prayer journal

    Your prayers are kept in a journal: topic, answers, recordings and saved passages. It stays on your device, and you can search it.

More in Lampada

  • Quiet music

    Fifteen calm tracks for prayer. Turn them on with one tap; they play even offline.

  • Reminders

    Choose when Lampada gently reminds you to pray.

  • PIN and Face ID

    Lock the app with a PIN. The code itself is never stored, so only you know it.

  • Share a prayer

    Send a prayer from your journal as text: its topic, your answers and saved passages.

Your prayer stays yours

We take your privacy very seriously.

Read the privacy policy→
  • Prayers, answers and recordings are kept on your device.
  • AI works only with your permission, separately for each feature. You can pray without it too.
  • Text you allow is processed by our server and Google Gemini. Our server keeps no archive of prayers.
  • The app has no ads, analytics SDKs, trackers or profiles. Our server keeps technical request statistics. Your PIN itself is never stored or sent.
